items.definition:
a portable video camera and recorder
He used his old camcorder to film the family vacation.

a small, striped rodent
A chipmunk scurried across the lawn and up a tree.

A large, arboreal lizard native to tropical America.
An iguana was basking in the sun on the rock.

a rope with a noose, used for catching animals
The cowboy threw the lasso to catch the runaway horse.

a person who rides a motorcycle
The motorcyclist wore a helmet for safety.

a theatre in which images of stars, planets, and other celestial objects are projected
We visited the planetarium to learn about the constellations.

a person who plays the saxophone
The jazz band featured a talented saxophonist who played an incredible solo.

soybean or products made from it
Many vegetarians use soya milk as an alternative to dairy milk.

a strap worn over the shoulder to hold up trousers or a skirt
He wore suspenders to keep his trousers up.

a strip of material forming the waist of a garment
The elastic waistband made the trousers comfortable.

a plant of the daisy family, with an edible flower head
I love eating steamed artichoke with butter.

a large African or Arabian monkey
We saw a baboon grooming itself at the zoo.

a person or company that provides food and drink for social events
We hired a caterer for the wedding reception.

the area around a fireplace
We gathered around the fireside, enjoying the warmth and telling stories.

the steering bar of a bicycle or motorcycle
He gripped the handlebars tightly as he rode down the hill.

a person or thing that closely resembles another
She was often mistaken for a celebrity lookalike.

the summit or peak of a mountain
They hiked for hours to reach the mountaintop.

stinging plant
Be careful not to touch the nettles; they sting.

a building separate from a main house
They stored their tools in the small outbuilding behind the house.

paper with sand or other abrasive material on one side, used for smoothing or polishing
He used sandpaper to smooth the rough edges of the wood.

a strong wind carrying clouds of sand, especially in a desert
The desert travelers were caught in a sudden sandstorm.

a powerful beam of light projected from a lamp with a reflector, used to illuminate distant objects
The prison guards shone a searchlight across the yard.

material in the form of sheets, especially for beds
We bought new sheeting to make curtains.

short for streptococcus, a type of bacteria that can cause infections
The doctor said I have strep throat.

a single drop of tears; something shaped like a tear
A single teardrop rolled down her cheek.

an article or preparation used in washing, grooming, or enhancing one's appearance
She packed all her toiletries in a small bag for the trip.

a row of icons or buttons on a computer screen that activate certain functions
Click the save icon on the toolbar to save your document.

an entertainer who performs spectacular gymnastic feats
The acrobat performed amazing flips and twists.

a small, common salt-water forage fish
I like anchovies on my pizza.

a receptacle for tobacco ash and cigarette butts
He flicked the ash into the ashtray.

a type of bread made with cornmeal
She served the chili with a side of warm cornbread.

wood that has been washed ashore by the sea or a river
We collected pieces of driftwood on the beach to decorate our home.

a person's hairstyle
She got a new hairdo for the party.

a child (informal)
The kiddy was playing happily in the park.

a person who fells trees
The lumberjack skillfully cut down the tall pine tree.

a snack food
I need some munchies to go with my movie.

a small table or cabinet next to a bed
She placed her book and glasses on the nightstand before going to sleep.

A shed for boats.
They kept their small rowboat in the boathouse by the lake.

A person who plays the cello.
The cellist played a beautiful solo during the concert.

A leafy green vegetable.
We harvested fresh chard from the garden for dinner.

The end or final part.
The closing of the store left many people without jobs.

A spider's web, especially an old, dusty one.
There were cobwebs in the corners of the old attic.

A tool for pulling corks from bottles.
I need a corkscrew to open this bottle of wine.

A small pitcher for cream, or a dairy product for coffee.
Would you like some creamer with your coffee?

A greenish-blue color.
The printer was running low on cyan ink.

A part of a device that fits into the ear.
The secret agent spoke into his earpiece.

A five-pound note or five-dollar bill.
Can you lend me a fiver until tomorrow?

A plank of wood forming part of a floor.
The old floorboards creaked under his weight.

A small, open building in a garden.
They enjoyed their picnic in the garden gazebo.

a large flatfish, used for food
We had grilled halibut for dinner last night.

a pipe with a nozzle and valve, usually in the street, for drawing water from a main, especially for fighting fires
The firefighters connected their hose to the nearest fire hydrant.

a person or device that lifts
The weightlifter was a strong lifter, easily handling heavy weights.

a person who cuts down trees for timber
The logger carefully felled the tall pine tree.

a liquid used to rinse the mouth
She used mouthwash after brushing her teeth.

a cosmetic treatment of the feet and toenails
She treated herself to a relaxing pedicure at the spa.

a genre of popular music
Elvis Presley was known as the King of Rock 'n' Roll.

a bird that lives near the sea
We watched the seabirds soaring over the cliffs.

a chewy candy
We bought some saltwater taffy at the beach.

a person who tastes food or drink; a small sample
The wine taster evaluated the new vintage.

a burrowing mammal with a bony shell
We saw an armadillo digging in the garden last night.

a sheet of canvas or other material stretched on a frame and used to keep the sun or rain off a storefront or house
We sat under the awning to escape the midday sun.

a member of a musical band
He's been playing with his bandmates for over ten years.

a single-portion takeout or home-packed meal common in Japanese cuisine
She packed a delicious bento box for her lunch.

a large, powerful hound of a breed noted for its acute sense of smell
A bloodhound was used to track the missing person.
